name: com.darhai/imap-mcp
title: Email (IMAP) - read & draft
description: Read your mail and write drafts into your Drafts folder. It cannot send: you review and press Send yourself. Works with iCloud, Gmail, Fastmail, Proton Bridge and any IMAP host.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: IMAP server hostname, e.g. imap.fastmail.com or imap.gmail.com.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: IMAP port. 993 for TLS, which is almost always right.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_USER
environmentVariables.description: IMAP username - usually your full email address.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App-specific password. Never your main account password. It stays on this machine and is never shown to the model.

environmentVariables.name: IMAP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false only for a local or plaintext server such as a test instance.
